Title: Administrator - A. View inspections on a work order line
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A work order line has at least one inspection.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open a work order that has an inspection on a line.
3. Locate the inspection on the line.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Login succeeds.
Step 2: Work order opens.
Step 3: Existing inspections on the line are visible. Edit controls (Add/bin/Open) appear only if the role has the relevant Work Order Lines rights; otherwise the inspection is read-only.

Title: Administrator - B. Add inspection to a work order line
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A work order with at least one line exists.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open a work order and locate a line.
3. Open the three-dot menu on the line.
4. Select Add Inspection and choose a template.
Expected Result:
Step 3: The three-dot menu shows Add Inspection.
Step 4: The inspection template is added and "Inspection added to line." is shown.

Title: Administrator - C. Add multiple inspection templates to one line
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A work order line exists.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Add an inspection template to a line.
3. Add a second and third template to the same line.
4. Attempt to add a fourth.
Expected Result:
Step 2: First inspection added ("Inspection added to line.").
Step 3: Second and third inspections added to the same line.
Step 4: VIU - spec does not state a maximum; build observed up to 3 per line. Confirm whether a 4th is prevented.

Title: Administrator - D. Open and fill an in-progress inspection
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A line has an in-progress inspection.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open an in-progress inspection on a line (click Open).
3. Attempt to fill/edit the inspection items.
Expected Result:
Step 2: The inspection opens.
Step 3: Inspection items can be filled/edited (provided the line is not marked complete).

Title: Administrator - E. Complete an inspection (Submit and Generate Report)
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. An inspection is in progress with required fields fillable.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open an in-progress inspection.
3. Fill all required fields.
4. Click Submit and Generate Report.
Expected Result:
Step 3: With no required field outstanding, the Submit and Generate Report button is visible and clickable.
Step 4: The inspection is submitted, a report is generated, and status becomes "Completed".

Title: Administrator - F. Inspection at 100 percent but not submitted shows Open
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. An inspection can be filled to 100 percent without submitting.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Fill all inspection items to 100 percent but do NOT click Submit and Generate Report.
3. Observe the inspection status on the line.
Expected Result:
Step 2: All items show filled (100 percent).
Step 3: The inspection still shows "Open" (not "Completed") because Submit and Generate Report has not been clicked.

Title: Administrator - G. Inspection status labels display correctly
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A line has inspections in different states.
Steps:
1. Open a work order line with inspections in different states.
2. Observe the status labels.
Expected Result: Step 2: A completed inspection shows "Completed"; an in-progress inspection shows "In Progress" with a percentage of completion.

Title: Administrator - H. Remove an in-progress inspection
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A line has an in-progress / not-started inspection.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open the line with an in-progress inspection.
3. Look for / click the bin (remove) icon.
4. Confirm removal if prompted.
Expected Result:
Step 3: A confirmation dialog appears: "Remove inspection - Are you sure you want to remove this inspection?" (Cancel / Remove).
Step 4: On Remove, the inspection is removed from the line.

Title: Administrator - I. Remove a completed inspection
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A line has a completed inspection with a generated PDF report.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open the line with a completed inspection.
3. Look for / click the bin (remove) icon.
4. Confirm removal if prompted.
Expected Result:
Step 3: A confirmation dialog appears: "Remove inspection - This inspection has a generated PDF report. Are you sure you want to remove it?" (Cancel / Remove).
Step 4: On Remove, the completed inspection is removed.
Build note: removal may require the work order line to NOT be marked complete (mark line Uncomplete first).

Title: Administrator - J. Reopen a completed inspection
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A line has a completed inspection.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open the line with a completed inspection.
3. Click Open against the inspection.
Expected Result:
Step 3: The completed inspection reopens for editing via the Open control.
Step 4: VIU - confirm reopen behavior for an inspection already submitted with a generated PDF report (open question from build testing).

Title: Administrator - K. Configure Inspection Templates (Settings > Service)
Section: Custom Roles and Permissions > Digital Inspections > Administrator
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Go to Settings > Service.
3. Open Inspection Templates.
4. Create a new template with fields.
Expected Result:
Step 2: Settings > Service is accessible.
Step 3: The Inspection Templates section is available.
Step 4: A new template can be created with fields: Checklist, Short Text, Long Text, Measurements, Photo, Instructions.
